title: Raising a flavor's tested minimum can orphan a requirement selector and fail matrix generation
answers: set-matrix fails with Found unused requirements error after bumping a minimum version
ValueError unused requirements in flavors matrix for transformers models
how do I raise the minimum ML package version without breaking the cross-version matrix
peft pin removed when transformers minimum bumped
body:
Symptom: The flavors CI matrix job (set-matrix) fails with "Found unused requirements '< 4.45' for transformers / models" right after the minimum version of a flavor is raised.
Root cause: mlflow/ml-package-versions.yml:transformers.models/autologging `requirements` contains a selector ("< 4.45": ["peft<0.14.0"]) whose range no longer overlaps the new [minimum, maximum] window, so it matches zero candidate versions. dev/flavors/src/flavors/_matrix.py:validate_requirements treats that as an error.
Fix pattern: When advancing `minimum` for a flavor in mlflow/ml-package-versions.yml, also delete every requirement selector whose upper bound is at or below the new minimum. Keep selectors that still match at least one version inside [minimum, maximum] (here "< 4.52": ["peft<0.18.0"] stayed because 4.45–4.51 exist).
Constraints: Applies to every selector under `requirements:` in the yml for models and autologging. Check both sections, since each has its own requirements block. Does not apply to selectors that still overlap the window. Run `flavors matrix --no-dev` locally to confirm, as the PR did.
applies: Any change to a flavor's minimum/maximum in mlflow/ml-package-versions.yml.
says: The automated test matrix pipeline fails after increasing a package minimum version.
Matrix generation complains about unused requirement rules for older library releases.
Remove obsolete dependency constraints when raising the baseline package support floor.
Ensure cross-version test generation succeeds when updating supported model framework versions.
Check both model flavor and autologging dependency settings for orphaned version pins.
search: When raising a flavor's minimum version in mlflow/ml-package-versions.yml, delete every requirement selector whose upper bound is at or below the new minimum so dev/flavors/src/flavors/_matrix.py:validate_requirements does not fail the set-matrix CI job with unused requirements. Keep selectors that still overlap the candidate [minimum, maximum] window, and verify both models and autologging requirements sections since each has its own requirements block. Applies to flavor minimum/maximum version changes in mlflow/ml-package-versions.yml, and can be verified locally using the command flavors matrix --no-dev.
